tools.name: purchase_storage_capacity_block
tools.description: Buys a prepaid block of object storage capacity for an account by charging the account's saved payment method on file. Returns the charge ID, the amount billed and the number of terabytes purchased.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the storage account being billed.

params.name: terabytes
params.description: Number of terabytes of capacity to purchase (1-500).

params.name: storage_class
params.description: Storage tier for the block: 'standard', 'infrequent' or 'archive'.

tools.code:
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass

import stripe
from agents import function_tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_SECRET_KEY"]

_PRICE_PER_TB_CENTS = {"standard": 2100, "infrequent": 1250, "archive": 400}


@dataclass
class CapacityPurchase:
    charge_id: str
    amount_cents: int
    terabytes: int
    storage_class: str
    status: str


@function_tool
def purchase_storage_capacity_block(customer_id: str, terabytes: int, storage_class: str = "standard") -> CapacityPurchase:
    if storage_class not in _PRICE_PER_TB_CENTS:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown storage class: {storage_class}")
    if terabytes < 1 or terabytes > 500:
        raise ValueError("terabytes must be between 1 and 500")
    customer = stripe.Customer.retrieve(customer_id)
    payment_method = customer["invoice_settings"]["default_payment_method"]
    if not payment_method:
        raise RuntimeError("Customer has no default payment method")
    amount = _PRICE_PER_TB_CENTS[storage_class] * terabytes
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        payment_method=payment_method,
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"{terabytes} TB {storage_class} object storage capacity block",
        metadata={"storage_class": storage_class, "terabytes": str(terabytes)},
    )
    return CapacityPurchase(
        charge_id=intent["latest_charge"],
        amount_cents=amount,
        terabytes=terabytes,
        storage_class=storage_class,
        status=intent["status"],
    )

tools.name: run_gateway_healthcheck_script
tools.description: Runs the storage gateway healthcheck script for a given gateway node and returns its exit code and console output.

params.name: gateway_node
params.description: Hostname of the storage gateway node to check, e.g. 'gw-east-02'.

params.name: timeout_seconds
params.description: Maximum time to let the script run before aborting.

tools.code:
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool

_SCRIPT = Path("/opt/objstore/bin/gateway_healthcheck.sh")


@function_tool
def run_gateway_healthcheck_script(gateway_node: str, timeout_seconds: int = 120) -> dict:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [str(_SCRIPT), "--node", gateway_node],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=timeout_seconds,
    )
    return {
        "gateway_node": gateway_node,
        "exit_code": proc.returncode,
        "healthy": proc.returncode == 0,
        "stdout": proc.stdout[-4000:],
        "stderr": proc.stderr[-2000:],
    }

tools.name: validate_restored_objects_against_manifest
tools.description: Reads a restore manifest of object keys and expected SHA-256 checksums, runs sha256sum over the locally restored copies, and reports which objects match, mismatch or are missing.

params.name: manifest_path
params.description: Path to the JSON manifest mapping object keys to expected SHA-256 hex digests.

params.name: restore_dir
params.description: Local directory where the objects were restored, laid out by object key.
